seat_fit.placement: pelvis x/z on kfb_driver_hidden, facing +Z; lowest foot on the hull floor (raycast down from kfb_driver_hidden)
seat_fit.method: three.js Raycaster against the 100k-tri browser hull: head+ears up, shoulders +-X, hips down; inside = first hit is an exit face
seat_fit.criteria: head/ears >= 5 cm below roof, shoulders inside side walls, hips above floor
